# Coding Standard

These principles apply to implementation work in this repository.

- Prefer simple solutions over unnecessary abstraction.
- Follow SOLID principles where they improve maintainability.
- Follow DRY, but do not introduce abstraction solely to eliminate small
  duplication.
- Prefer clear and explicit code over clever code.
- Follow the existing repository architecture and conventions.
- Keep modules focused on a single responsibility.
- Minimize coupling between components.
- Avoid speculative generalization.
- Write code that is testable and maintainable.
- Do not perform unrelated refactoring within a Story.
